mapper.sql: id, source_type, owner_user_id, name, city, location, activity_time, mood, scene, budget, activity_type, style, duration, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_item ( source_type, owner_user_id, name, city, location, activity_time, mood, scene, budget, activity_type, style, duration, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceType}, #{ownerUserId}, #{name}, #{city}, #{location}, #{activityTime}, #{mood}, #{scene}, #{budget}, #{activityType}, #{style}, #{duration}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_item SET name = #{name}, city = #{city}, location = #{location}, activity_time = #{activityTime}, mood = #{mood}, scene = #{scene}, budget = #{budget}, activity_type = #{activityType}, style = #{style}, duration = #{duration}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM activity_item WHERE source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT FROM activity_item WHERE source_type = 'PUBLIC' AND owner_user_id IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM activity_item WHERE source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{userId}
